purpose: Recover only the 450/650/750-nm secondary computational-precision measurement after the target+550 AOD-normalization transport mechanism passed a separate preregistered exact-runtime compatibility probe. Preserve all physical inputs and all original secondary precision thresholds; use fresh seeds and no Taylor/Jerusalem or empirical lunar residuals.

prerequisiteEvidence.compatibilityInterpretation: The exact runtime can execute the frozen target+550 sparse-source mechanism with aerosol_set_tau_at_wvl 550 unchanged and mc_spectral_is absent, returning finite positive target radiance and target mcStd at 450/650/750 nm. Probe magnitudes are not precision evidence and are not used to set any threshold or parameter.

sourceAndRuntime.sparseSourceRule: For every target case, copy exactly the target-nm and 550-nm rows from the frozen full 380..780 nm 1-nm lunar source. No interpolation, renormalization, fitting, or distance scaling is introduced by the sparse source.

numericalDesign.seedAssignmentOrder: target wavelength ascending, observer elevation ascending, relative azimuth ascending, replicate ascending
numericalDesign.reasonPhotonSettingUnchanged: The target MYSTIC photon directive remains 5,000,000 exactly as preregistered before the failed exec001. The added 550-nm anchor exists only to satisfy the frozen AOD550 transport requirement and is excluded from secondary precision acceptance. No photon setting was changed in response to observed precision magnitudes.

precisionEvaluation.replicateConsistencyDefinition: abs(L1-L2)/sqrt(sigma1^2+sigma2^2), using only the intended target wavelength radiance and MYSTIC mc.rad.std.spc from the two independent target replicates
precisionEvaluation.zeroStdHandling: fail precision support; never substitute epsilon, empirical replicate spread, anchor-wavelength uncertainty, or a fitted uncertainty
precisionEvaluation.anchor550Use: structural/diagnostic only; anchor radiance and mcStd may be recorded but may not enter any target precision gate, threshold, fit, weighting, or classification
precisionEvaluation.passRule: Execution must first be complete for all 36 inputs. Then every target replicate must have finite positive radiance, strictly positive target mcStd and target relativeMcStd <=0.10, and all 18 target-wavelength-by-geometry replicate z checks must be finite and <=4.0.
precisionEvaluation.executionIncompleteRule: Any nonzero uvspec exit or missing required target radiance/std output yields EXECUTION_INCOMPLETE, not a computational-precision failure.
precisionEvaluation.precisionFailureRule: Only an execution-complete dataset may be classified FAIL_SECONDARY_PRECISION.
precisionEvaluation.failureAction: Do not rerun/retry/resume this identity or alter photons/thresholds after results. Any further continuation requires a new frozen contract and new seeds.

combinedParentRecoveryRule.parent550NmRequiredEvidence: All six immutable 550-nm replicate pairs passed z<=4 and every 550-nm replicate had relative mcStd <=0.05 in artifact 9727358391.
